long_biography.plain_text:
Ekstein Development Group grew around an integrated model: acquire or develop New York property, retain ownership and management, and use affiliated construction companies to deliver much of the work. Its projects range from affordable rentals to luxury condominiums, while storage, industrial and office facilities broaden the portfolio.

Ekstein also applied the property platform to specialised operating spaces. He oversees self-storage and records-management businesses, music rehearsal studios and two Queens ice rinks, including World Ice Arena in Flushing Meadows Corona Park. More recent mixed-use work in Brooklyn pairs market-rate and attainable housing, extending the group's reach beyond conventional apartment development.
